name: OLD MAN
description: An elderly man wearing an orange rain cape encountered at a ferry pier in fog. He appears to be connected to a covert exchange involving a cash box and envelope.

explicit_evidence.quote: Windows aren't much use in this fog.

inferred_traits.value: Likely participant in or observer of the envelope/cash box exchange
inferred_traits.rationale: His presence at the pier, cryptic greeting, and knowledge of Lena's actions suggest involvement in the transaction or surveillance of it.

inferred_traits.value: Knows the ferry pier and its operations
inferred_traits.rationale: He stands by the gangway and makes reference to fog and windows, suggesting prior knowledge of the location.

dialogue_summary: The Old Man greets Lena with a cryptic acknowledgment that she found something, then deflects her question about being at her window with an evasive comment about fog obscuring windows.

relationships.evidence: Encounters Lena at the pier and exchanges dialogue about the cash box discovery; appears to know her activities.
